method: string scan + Capstone xref/CMP hunt; TRACE-interned asserts block numeric recovery for MAX_PRIORITIES / NAME_LEN / HEAP / TICK

entries.name: kernel_version
entries.notes: Same banner attributed to M55 CMSIS-RTOS2 stack in RTOS_MAP; co-located with HiFi4/Xtensa port assert cluster (see hifi4_port).

entries.name: cmsis_rtos2_shim
entries.evidence: source path cmsis_os2.c + API symbols (osThreadSetPriority/GetPriority/Yield/Suspend/Resume, osDelay/osDelayUntil, osEventFlags*, osMutex*, osSemaphore*, osMessageQueue*)
entries.notes: CMSIS-RTOS2 over FreeRTOS; osThreadNew fail log also at 0x160808.

entries.name: configMAX_PRIORITIES
entries.evidence: assert string `( uxNewPriority < configMAX_PRIORITIES )` beside `vTaskPrioritySet` in tasks.c cluster
entries.notes: assert present @ 0x12CB89 but 0 literal-pool / interior VA refs (TRACE-interned); Capstone CMP hunt unbound

entries.name: configTOTAL_HEAP_SIZE
entries.evidence: no `configTOTAL_HEAP_SIZE` / `ucHeap` / sized heap banner in image; heap_4 present but array extent not statically bound
entries.notes: Do not confuse with multi_heap / med_heap / LV_MEM pools elsewhere.

entries.name: configTICK_RATE_HZ
entries.evidence: no `configTICK_RATE_HZ` / `osKernelGetTickFreq` / `OS_TICK_FREQ` string; tick/ms dump formats exist under RTX introspection only
entries.notes: LVGL `lvgl_os_tick_timer` proves a software tick consumer, not the rate.

entries.name: configMINIMAL_STACK_SIZE
entries.evidence: format `%%d-%%s minisize %%d` @ test_freertos.c cluster prints a runtime minisize but the immediate is not recoverable (no VA xref)
entries.notes: Idle/Timer daemon stack sizes also unrecovered statically.

entries.name: configCHECK_FOR_STACK_OVERFLOW
entries.notes: Method 1 vs 2 (canary-only vs canary+SP check) not distinguished; value left as enabled-not-enumerated.

entries.name: configSUPPORT_DYNAMIC_ALLOCATION
entries.evidence: `xQueueGenericCreate` + `pvPortMalloc`/`vPortFree` heap_4 asserts (dynamic path compiled alongside static)

entries.name: configUSE_TIMERS
entries.evidence: timers.c path + timer daemon name `Tmr Svc` + `xTimerCreateTimerTask`

entries.name: portBYTE_ALIGNMENT
entries.evidence: `( xWantedSize & portBYTE_ALIGNMENT_MASK ) == 0` in heap_4; mask width not bound to an immediate via xref
entries.notes: Cortex-M ports commonly use 8, but that default is not evidenced here.

entries.name: hifi4_freertos_port
entries.notes: No ARM_CM55 / GCC/ARM_CMx FreeRTOS port path strings in this image; M55 kernel port path unrecovered (BES custom / stripped).

entries.name: smf_thread_hifi4
entries.notes: HiFi4 SMF thread wrapper over FreeRTOS; stack used/total only at runtime.

entries.name: cmsis_osThreadFlags_max
entries.evidence: osEventFlags* API strings present; no `osThreadFlags*` / `osFlagsError*` banners; 31-bit CMSIS default not proven from immediates

entries.name: cmsis_osMessageQueue_max
entries.evidence: `osMessageQueuePut/Get/Reset/Delete` present; no compile-time max capacity constant recovered
entries.notes: Per-queue capacities belong to leaf stacks/IPC inventories, not kernel config.

entries.name: idle_task_name
entries.notes: Standard FreeRTOS idle task name when configIDLE_TASK_NAME unset/default.
